While the page correctly lists the members as "Royce da 5′9″ ("bad") and Eminem ("evil") and explicitly states they are a "super duo composed of Detroit-based rappers Royce da 5′9″ and Eminem," the Planner hallucinated that the second member was "Supa Dups." This error led to the generation of an incorrect final answer.
